title.zh: 反馈回路与自动检查方法论

question.zh: 怎样让 agent 自己发现错误,而不是靠人逐行检查?
question.en: How do you get an agent to find its own mistakes instead of having a person check every line?

text.zh: 给 agent 足够的自动反馈:类型检查、测试、格式化、lint,用提交前钩子和 CI 强制执行。agent 不怕重复,失败了就会再试,所以这些摩擦对 AI 编程来说是好事。每犯一次错,就想办法把模糊的规则变成确定性检查。
text.en: Give the agent plenty of automatic feedback: type checks, tests, formatting and lint, enforced by pre-commit hooks and CI. Agents don't mind repetition and will retry after a failure, so this friction is a good thing for AI coding. Every time a mistake happens, look for a way to turn a vague rule into a deterministic check.

anchors.quote: you need feedback loops so the AI can verify its own work.
anchors.quote_zh: 你需要反馈回路,让 AI 能验证自己的工作。

anchors.quote: Friction via pre-commit hooks/CI/strong types is now super desirable
anchors.quote_zh: 通过提交前钩子、CI、强类型制造的摩擦,现在非常可取

title.zh: 类型检查作为第一道免费反馈
title.en: Type checking is the first free feedback

how.zh: 用 TypeScript 而不是 JavaScript,在 package.json 里加 typecheck 脚本。类型能抓住很多 agent 不开浏览器就发现不了的错误。
how.en: Use TypeScript rather than JavaScript and add a typecheck script to package.json. Types catch many errors an agent would otherwise miss without opening a browser.

anchors.quote: is essentially free feedback for your AI. Use it over JavaScript.
anchors.quote_zh: (TypeScript)本质上是给 AI 的免费反馈。用它而不是 JavaScript。

how.zh: 用测试框架覆盖核心逻辑;更多地考虑集成测试,让 agent 改动后能跑测试确认行为没变。
how.en: Cover the core logic with a test framework and lean more towards integration tests, so the agent can run them after a change and confirm the behaviour still holds.

anchors.quote: Basic unit tests covering core functionality help keep the AI on track.
anchors.quote_zh: 覆盖核心功能的基础单元测试能让 AI 不跑偏。

anchors.quote: WAY more time thinking about integration testing
anchors.quote_zh: 花多得多的时间思考集成测试

title.zh: 用提交前钩子强制执行

how.zh: 提交前自动跑格式化、类型检查和测试,任何一步失败就阻止提交,agent 会拿到报错信息再修。合并到主分支和部署前,在 CI 里再检查一遍。
how.en: Run formatting, type checks and tests automatically before each commit and block the commit if any step fails; the agent gets the error and fixes it. Check again in CI before merging to the main branch and deploying.

anchors.quote: If any step fails, the commit is blocked and the AI gets an error message.
anchors.quote_zh: 任何一步失败,提交就被阻止,AI 会收到错误信息。

anchors.quote: Always ensure types are correct on PR's to main
anchors.quote_zh: 始终确保合并到 main 的 PR 类型正确

title.zh: 让 agent 能看到运行中的应用
title.en: Let the agent see the running app

how.zh: 静态检查只能看到代码本身。还要让 agent 能访问本地运行的开发服务器,或者至少能读到它的日志输出(例如把输出写进文件,在 AGENTS.md 里注明位置)。这样前端改动、运行时报错也能形成反馈,不必每次都由人打开浏览器检查后再转述给 agent。
how.en: Static checks only see the code. Also let the agent reach the local dev server, or at least read its log output (for example written to a file whose location is noted in AGENTS.md). Front-end changes and runtime errors then give feedback too, without a person opening the browser each time and relaying what they saw.

title.zh: 把每次犯错变成确定性检查
title.en: Turn every mistake into a deterministic check

how.zh: 出了错就做复盘,把「请不要这样做」之类模糊的规则,改写成自定义 lint 规则、提交前钩子或 CI 工作流,让同样的错误以后不可能再发生。
how.en: When something goes wrong, review it and rewrite vague rules such as "please don't do this" as something a machine enforces: your own lint rule, a hook that runs before each commit, or a check in CI, so the same mistake cannot happen again.

anchors.quote: Found an error? Do a /retro, and make it impossible next time
anchors.quote_zh: 发现错误?做一次 /retro,让它下次不可能再发生
配合严格的 lint 规则

body.zh:
# .husky/pre-commit
npx lint-staged      # 格式化已暂存文件
npm run typecheck    # tsc
npm run test         # 单元/集成测试
body.en:
# .husky/pre-commit
npx lint-staged      # format staged files
npm run typecheck    # tsc
npm run test         # unit/integration tests

text.zh: 没有反馈回路就让 Ralph 这类 AFK 循环跑。
text.en: Running an AFK loop like Ralph without feedback loops.

anchors.quote_zh: 之前:Ralph 产出的全是垃圾

text.en: Automated checks that are too loose.

anchors.quote: Your automated checks are too lax
anchors.quote_zh: 你的自动检查太宽松了

text.zh: 在每个场景都强制类型正确,反而拖慢开发。人类开发者只需在关键节点卡住。
text.en: Forcing type correctness everywhere, which slows development down. Human developers only need a gate at key points.

anchors.quote: All other cases slow you down unnecessarily
anchors.quote_zh: 其他所有情况都会无谓地拖慢你

stance.zh: 人类团队时代:只在 PR 合并到 main 和部署前强制类型正确。
stance.en: Human teams: type correctness is enforced only when a PR merges to main and before deploying.

stance.zh: AI 编程让摩擦变成好事:每个 TS 项目都配置类型、测试、钩子和格式化,作为 AFK 循环的前提。
stance.en: AI coding makes friction a good thing: every TS project gets types, tests, hooks and formatting as the precondition for AFK loops.

stance.zh: 把复盘得到的规则写成确定性检查;认为软件开发容易自动化,正是因为它有大量高质量的自动反馈回路。
stance.en: Rules found in reviews become deterministic checks; he thinks software development is easy to automate precisely because it has so many high-quality automatic feedback loops.

anchors.quote: Tons of high quality automated feedback loops (types, tests)
anchors.quote_zh: 大量高质量的自动反馈回路(类型、测试)
